mostWorthwhile.text: Building the turning and weighted sensors was worthwhile because the pictures showed how movement bends their hairs and changes signals.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to connect the balance organs directly to the nerves was confusing: it was not clear why that connection was unavailable yet.

surprise.text: The weighted sensors respond to changes in straight-line movement as well as tilt.

arbitrary.text: Having to join the two sensor types before connecting the nerves felt like an unexplained game prerequisite, although the compatibility hint helped.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter if it explains another familiar body function through pictures like these, though I would hope the connection order is clearer.
